اقتعدتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدْتُنَّ (iqtaʕadtunna) /iq.ta.ʕad.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدْتُنَّ (uqtuʕidtunna) /uq.tu.ʕid.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
